description: This file defines an abstract base class for testing the Reminder Table component in Orleans, including setup, teardown, and various test scenarios for reminder management.

classes.name: ReminderTableTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common setup, teardown, and test methods for reminder table testing in Orleans.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table before tests run.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up the reminder table after tests.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Abstract method to create a specific implementation of IReminderTable.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the database connection string.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the ADO invariant string, defaulting to null.

methods.name: RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Performs parallel upsert operations on reminders to test concurrency.

methods.name: ReminderSimple
methods.description: Performs a simple reminder insert, read, update, and delete cycle.

methods.name: RemindersRange
methods.description: Tests bulk insert and range queries of reminders.

methods.name: TestRemindersHashInterval
methods.description: Validates reading reminders within a hash interval.

methods.name: CreateReminder
methods.description: Creates a new ReminderEntry with specified grain ID and name.
